name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-bumpty
title: Super Mario World Styled Bumpty
description:
The sprite for these GFX can be found here.

People LOVE the Bumpty, and rightfully so! I just don't like how it doesn't really fit into SMW with the default Yoshi's Island graphics lol. These should be a nice alternative if you want your hack to look more consistent.
